title: Capture of Hưng Hóa
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Capture of Hưng Hóa", at revision 1370608852, opens: "The Capture of Hưng Hóa was an important French victory in the Tonkin Campaign (1883–86)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5037025, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1884 battle in the Tonkin Campaign". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
